paragraphs: The ScholarPredict project is a machine learning system designed to predict academic performance categories of students using Random Forest algorithm. The primary objective is to build an accurate and interpretable ensemble classification model for early intervention.

The data used in the project includes attributes such as attendance percentage, internal assessment marks, assignment scores, previous semester grades, weekly study hours, and participation in extracurricular activities.
